green_summary.cli_exit_code_contract_0_1_2: bin/cli.js (existing entry reworked, zero commands removed or renamed). requireProjectDir(): a missing/non-directory --project is invalid input, thrown into each command's existing catch -> JSON INVALID_* report + exit 1; wired into deliverable-audit, evidence-audit and test-gate (the three measured violations; probe/workflow-audit already exited 1 via their throw paths and were left untouched). New delivery-gate command exposes the P2_2 pure gate at the CLI: loads --contract (validated with parseContract SDD.Delivery.TestContract v1), --receipts (must be a JSON array of admission entries from the trusted-launcher path), --policy {ref,digest}, --input-digest (sha256 hex), --builder-execution; runs evaluate(inputs, receipts, policy) — no dispatch, no secret, no writes, receipts cannot be minted through it. Exit contract: 0 = verdict pass, 1 = invalid inputs (unreadable/schema-invalid/malformed), 2 = verdict blocked; --json prints { schemaVersion, verdict, receipt }. EVIDENCE_INPUT_MISSING deliberately keeps exit 2 (see blockers_or_questions).
green_summary.legacy_evidence_adapter: lib/adapters/legacy-evidence.js (new). adaptLegacyReport maps the old evidence-audit v1 report into an EvidenceEnvelope: candidateDigest <- evidenceSha256.sourceTree (the digest the old channel actually computed), caseId <- change, result <- pass/fail as-is, executions {total:1, valid:1} (the one real audit execution; no fabricated per-case counts — the old report has none), evidence[0] pins the report itself by stable-stringify sha256. B07: schemaVersion absent -> MISSING_FIELD (named), schemaVersion != 1 -> INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION, missing pass/issues/change/evidenceSha256 or identity fields -> explicit refusal; internal invariant re-validates the adapted envelope against the frozen schema (fail-closed). B10 layer honesty: origin.kind 'legacy-report', check 'report:evidence-audit:v1' — gate capability matching is exact, so the legacy layer can only close a required check named exactly that and can never substitute for a product capability. admitLegacyReport issues the dispatch through the caller's launch authority and calls admitEvidence UNCHANGED (import use, no modification): integrity, identity, currency, duplicate-issuance and class rules all remain admitEvidence's; with no authority the adapter refuses — it mints no trust.
green_summary.compatibility: Existing callers preserved (sweep: worker-reports/P2_3/evidence/caller-compat-sweep.txt): package.json bin path unchanged; VERSION const format untouched (version-consistency test green); all 7 pre-existing CLI command suites green (npm test 172/172); documented commands unchanged, delivery-gate is additive; old evidence-audit behavior on a real matching project verified exit 0 at task level (test 2.3 case 1).
